import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import statsmodels.api as sm

class LegacyModel:
    def __init__(self):
        self.woe_tabs = None
        self.coef_ = None

    def fit(self, frame: pd.DataFrame, train_rows: np.ndarray | None = None) -> "LegacyModel":
        # Create the target variable
        frame['bad'] = np.where(frame['creditability'] == 'bad', 1, 0)

        # Binning functions
        def bin_duration(x):
            return pd.cut(x, bins=[-np.inf, 12, 24, 36, np.inf], right=False, labels=["lt12", "12-24", "24-36", "36+"])

        def bin_amount(x):
            x[np.isnan(x)] = 0  # Missing amount = 0
            return pd.cut(x, bins=[-np.inf, 1400, 4000, 8000, np.inf], right=False, labels=["lt1400", "1400-4000", "4000-8000", "8000+"])

        # Create bins
        b = pd.DataFrame({
            'checking': frame['status.of.existing.checking.account'],
            'duration': bin_duration(frame['duration.in.month']),
            'history': frame['credit.history'],
            'purpose': frame['purpose'],
            'amount': bin_amount(frame['credit.amount']),
            'savings': frame['savings.account.and.bonds'],
            'employment': frame['present.employment.since'],
            'instalment': frame['installment.rate.in.percentage.of.disposable.income']
        })

        # WoE calculation
        G = np.sum(frame['bad'] == 0)
        B = np.sum(frame['bad'] == 1)
        self.woe_tabs = {}
        for v in b.columns:
            lv = b[v].unique()
            ng = [np.sum((b[v] == l) & (frame['bad'] == 0)) for l in lv]
            nb = [np.sum((b[v] == l) & (frame['bad'] == 1)) for l in lv]
            w = np.log((np.array(nb) + 0.5) / B / ((np.array(ng) + 0.5) / G))
            self.woe_tabs[v] = pd.DataFrame({'var': v, 'bin': lv, 'n_good': ng, 'n_bad': nb, 'woe': w})

        # Apply WoE
        X = pd.DataFrame(index=np.arange(len(b)))
        for v in b.columns:
            t = self.woe_tabs[v]
            X[f'woe_{v}'] = t['woe'][t['bin'].isin(b[v])].values

        X['bad'] = frame['bad']

        # Fit the model
        self.model = sm.GLM(X['bad'], sm.add_constant(X.drop(columns=['bad'])), family=sm.families.Binomial()).fit(tol=1e-12, maxiter=100)
        self.coef_ = self.model.params
        return self

    def score(self, frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # Create bins for scoring
        b = pd.DataFrame({
            'checking': frame['status.of.existing.checking.account'],
            'duration': pd.cut(frame['duration.in.month'], bins=[-np.inf, 12, 24, 36, np.inf], right=False, labels=["lt12", "12-24", "24-36", "36+"]),
            'history': frame['credit.history'],
            'purpose': frame['purpose'],
            'amount': pd.cut(frame['credit.amount'], bins=[-np.inf, 1400, 4000, 8000, np.inf], right=False, labels=["lt1400", "1400-4000", "4000-8000", "8000+"]),
            'savings': frame['savings.account.and.bonds'],
            'employment': frame['present.employment.since'],
            'instalment': frame['installment.rate.in.percentage.of.disposable.income']
        })

        # Apply WoE
        Xs = pd.DataFrame(index=np.arange(len(b)))
        for v in b.columns:
            t = self.woe_tabs[v]
            Xs[f'woe_{v}'] = t['woe'][t['bin'].isin(b[v])].values

        # Prediction
        pd_probs = self.model.predict(sm.add_constant(Xs))
        scores = 600 + (50 / np.log(2)) * np.log((1 - pd_probs) / pd_probs)
        decision = np.where(pd_probs > 0.35, 'DECLINE', 'APPROVE')

        return pd.DataFrame({'score': scores, 'decision': decision}, index=frame.index)

    @property
    def coef(self) -> pd.Series | None:
        if self.coef_ is not None:
            return self.coef_
        return None
